comments.content:
@pavlovcik Since this year's GitHub Accelerator program is dedicated to AI, it is advisable to place more emphasis on AI.
I think it is important to fully comply with at least 1 specific category:
- **AI powered** developer applications and tools
- Marketplaces and tools that **democratize access to AI**
For GitHub, our system can be called OS OS - Open Source Operating System.
Describe the system as a Copilot for Open Source organizations to orchestrate the entire development lifecycle on GitHub.
The value is productivity - motivating contributors and increasing the manageability of distributed teams creating Open Source projects on GitHub.
Mention, that the system itself is Open Source, modular, and powered with AI agents.
A part of the system is an AI-enhanced marketplace that facilitates the development of Open Source projects on GitHub.
If you wish, we can compile one more application to GitHub Accelerator.

@pavlovcik I`ve just realized that it might make sense to describe our solution in the same terms as GitHub named the categories interesting for them.
For example, Ubiquity builds an operation system with AI-powered developer tools and a task marketplace that democratizes access to AI for Open Source projects on GitHub.
In this case (realizing that this is some exaggeration):
- Ubiquity DAO OS Kernel (UbiquiBot Kernel) is the core of the system, the AI to which we give access (like AI repository Manager, AI Manager).
- Ubiquity DAO OS Plugins are AI-powered developer tools.
- DevPool is a task marketplace that gives access to AI.
Please let me know if you need my help with a description for GitHub.

Next version:
Ubiquity builds a DAO Task Operating System with AI-powered developer tools and a task marketplace.
Open Source projects on GitHub will benefit from a flexible framework for incentivizing contributors and democratizing access to AI.

## Intro
Some time ago we registered our interest in the GitHub Accelerator. Now we should fill out the full application form (below).
@pavlovcik Please give your input on this application
**From my point of view, Ubiquity can fit into such categories:**
- Marketplaces and tools that democratize access to AI
- AI powered developer applications and tools
As far as I understand, it will be possible to integrate AI into each of the Ubiquity DAO OS (UbiquiBot) plugins. Ubiquity DAO OS and DevPool act as a marketplace that will have AI functionality.
### The invitation
This year’s theme is open source AI because the pace of innovation and development is rapidly accelerating. GitHub wants to invite people and projects that are building AI based solutions under an open source license to improve the world around them to apply.
If you or a project you know is interested, please apply by March 5 12PM PST.
The program will kick-off April 22 for our 10 week peer-based cohort program filled with instruction, workshops, discussion, projects, and mentorship.
The 10-week Accelerator program will kick off on April 22 and include a mix of 1-to-1, group sessions, project work, and mentorships. Participants will also receive:
$40,000 per project in non-dilutive funding.
5-10 hours per week of live instruction, workshops, and homework.
Office Hours with the GitHub team for security reviews.
Q&As with enterprise GitHub Sponsors, community members, and GitHub leaders.
Introduction to, and at least one office hour with, M12, Microsoft’s Venture Fund. 
Free access to relevant GitHub products, including a full year of GitHub Copilot.
Eligible projects will receive free Azure AI infrastructure credits including preferred access to high-end GPU virtual machine clusters and white glove go-to-market support.
A shared slack channel with your cohort to collaborate and support each other.
Thanks,
GitHub Accelerator Team
### Information from the GitHub resources
**Links**
https://accelerator.github.com/
https://github.com/sponsors
https://docs.github.com/en/sponsors/getting-started-with-github-sponsors/about-github-sponsors#supported-regions-for-github-sponsors
**Supported regions for GitHub Sponsors**
Among supported: 
- South Korea
- United States
Not supported: 
- BVI
**FAQ**
We will select 10 projects for the cohort. All of our applications will be evaluated by a selection committee. You’ll be much more likely to be selected if you:
Have an active and growing set of users
Understand how you want to grow and maintain your project
Wish to pursue open source work full-time
AI Developers Tools and Infrastructure and Pipeline
Models and frameworks, including architectures
Hardware and hardware enablement
Data and data infrastructure
Marketplaces and tools that democratize access to AI
AI powered developer applications and tools
Cyber security
## 2024 GitHub Accelerator Application
- Email
- What is your first name?
- What is your last name?
- What is your GitHub Handle (e.g. @mona)?
- City
- State or Province
- Country
- What is your project?
- Sum up your project in under 5 sentences.
- What open source license are you using?
- What is your approximate community stage?
- What is the projects GitHub repo? Please enter the project repo's GitHub URL
- Please enter any URLs of websites or social media accounts associated with your project (if applicable).
- Are there other contributors to this project who want to join the GitHub Accelerator with you? What is their GitHub handle?
- Why do you want to be in open source full-time?
- What is your role and level of involvement in the project?
- What is your ideal funding strategy (e.g., enterprise sponsors, foundation grants, starting a company, venture capital)?
- How much money have you raised so far?
- Do you have an existing sponsorship strategy?
- Do you self-identify as an underrepresented person in tech? Please share.
By checking this box you agree that you must:
- Be age eighteen (18) or older;
- Be a current maintainer of an open source project on GitHub;.
- Have an active online profile on GitHub;
- Reside in one of the regions supported by [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors)
- Not be a current employee or contractor of GitHub and/or any of its parent/subsidiary companies (including Microsoft);
- Have an active and growing set of users as determined by GitHub;
- Understand how you want to grow and maintain your project.
- Agree to [Code of Conduct](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/github-terms/github-community-code-of-conduct) and [Privacy Statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-privacy-statement).
